items.title: Ford (F) And Geely Team Up To Revive Valencia With New European EVs
items.summary: Ford Motor (NYSE:F) and Geely announced a new joint venture to restart and repurpose Ford's Valencia plant. The partnership focuses on producing new electric and multi-energy vehicles for the European market. The companies plan to use the underutilized facility as a hub for low and zero emission models.
